resources.string:
ZipFlash is a lightweight and fast ZIP flashing utility for Android.
It allows you to flash scripts directly on your device using Shizuku.
It also includes a built-in shell to execute commands. Ideal for advanced users.

"I made this app to flash my compressed ZIP files and run scripts directly on my device.

Works both root and non-root."

Features:
- Flash compressed ZIP files easily
- Run custom scripts
- Built-in shell for command execution
- Lightweight and fast
- And more soon..

If you encounter any issues/problems or bugs, please contact me via email. contact: misterp321nimda@gmail.com

For more info and updates visit: zipflash website
